question: Should OpenClaw expose the new `tools.swarm`-gated QuickJS orchestration API as a supported core Code Mode capability with persisted replay semantics?
rationale: This is a new user-facing orchestration surface spanning Code Mode, agent lifecycle state, and persisted collector metadata; implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended long-term product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core surface
options.body: Accept the QuickJS Swarm API direction, then require restart/recovery proof and green checks before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep collector orchestration internal or omit restart replay semantics until a smaller supported Code Mode contract is agreed.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep the existing Swarm core without exposing it to QuickJS Code Mode until maintainers choose an API and persistence contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core surface
recommendation.body: Accept the QuickJS Swarm API direction, then require restart/recovery proof and green checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available design and implementation history identifies steipete as the clearest routing candidate for the intended Swarm Code Mode contract.
